questions.question: An angel appeared to the centurion Cornelius. What did the angel say his prayers and gifts to the poor had done?

answers.text: Gone up as a memorial offering before God
Paid for every wrong he had ever done
Been written down by the temple priests

questions.question: An angel told the centurion Cornelius to send men to Joppa to bring back which man?
In Peter's vision on a rooftop in Joppa, what was inside the large sheet let down from heaven?

answers.text: All kinds of animals and reptiles and birds
Stone tablets with the law written on them
Scrolls from the prophets of Israel

questions.question: The Spirit told Peter to go with three men looking for him without hesitation. What reason did the Spirit give?

answers.text: He had sent the men Himself
They were old friends of Peter
